# STR2G – online HYROX training programs

> STR2G (Stronger Together) sells structured online HYROX training programs and 1:1 online HYROX coaching by coaches Ladislav Suchánek and Ria Suchánek Hrušovská (Prague, Czech Republic). Programs run in the Strivee app; plans, videos and support are in English (translation by arrangement). Website in 9 languages.

## Programs (prices in CZK)
- HYROX Basic – monthly plan, foundation, beginners: 750 / month
- HYROX Competitor – monthly plan for regular racers: 960 / month
- HYROX Pro Athlete – monthly plan, advanced: 1,350 / month
- 12-Week HYROX Race Prep: 1,900 one-time
- 8-Week HYROX Singles: 1,500 one-time
- 8-Week HYROX Doubles: 1,700 one-time
- Running for HYROX 2.0 (12-week running block): 1,000 one-time
- 2-Week HYROX Taper 2.0: 550 one-time
- HYROX Individual Program 1:1 (online coaching): 3,500 / month
